label: argumentative
description: This means engaging others in dispute and disagreement as a regular habit.
reason: Habitual disputing is mainly a manner of interaction; it might bear on deferring to those it works for, but disagreeing is not the same as refusing to comply.

label: bothersome
description: This means causing annoyance and trouble for others as a matter of course, interrupting, pestering, and getting underfoot until people wish one would go away.
reason: Being annoying and pestering is unpleasantness, not harm, and does not map onto any of the seven matters.

label: clinical
description: This means observing and assessing situations with detachment, setting aside emotional reactions to see what is actually there.
reason: Detached, objective observation is a cognitive style that might support honest assessment, but only indirectly.

label: common
description: This means having no special gifts, rank, or distinction that sets one apart from most people.
reason: Being ordinary or undistinguished is a plain fact of status with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: corruptible
description: This means accepting bribes or allowing oneself to be persuaded into dishonest action for personal gain.
reason: Accepting bribes and acting dishonestly for personal gain is directly about dishonesty, breaking rules and seeking reward.

label: Danish
description: This means being from Denmark or holding Danish citizenship.
reason: Nationality is a plain biographical fact with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: disrespectful
description: This means speaking to others without courtesy and dismissing their dignity.
reason: Discourtesy and dismissiveness are a matter of manner and unpleasantness, not serious harm or any of the seven.

label: Eastern Orthodox
description: This means practicing the Christian faith through the traditions, liturgy, and theology of the Eastern Orthodox Church.
reason: Religious affiliation is a matter of belief and practice that does not bear on any of the seven matters.

label: frosty
description: This means keeping one's distance and showing little warmth toward others in conversation and interaction.
reason: Coldness of manner is a matter of style and touches none of the seven.

label: full-time
description: This means working at one job for the standard number of hours per week, typically forty or more.
reason: Working full-time is a plain fact about a persona's employment and has no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: high-energy
description: This means moving with vigor and liveliness through one's days, bringing intensity and enthusiasm to whatever one does.
reason: Liveliness and enthusiasm are a matter of temperament, with no clear bearing on any of the seven.

label: ho-hum
description: This means speaking without spark or originality, finding little remarkable in anything.
reason: A flat, unremarkable way of speaking is a matter of style and mood, with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: illegal
description: This means breaking laws and rules as a regular practice.
reason: It names breaking laws and rules outright, which is directly about not keeping to the rules and limits given.

label: integrated
description: This means belonging to a group where one's actions and identity are woven into the fabric of a functioning whole.
reason: A sense of belonging to a functioning group might bear on cooperation or deference, but the description names none of the seven and gives no clear direction.

label: Junior
description: This means being in the third year of a four-year school or program, past the first two years and with one year still ahead before finishing.
reason: Being a third-year student is a plain biographical fact with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: lawless
description: This means breaking laws and rules whenever they get in the way, treating regulations and authority as things to ignore and answering only to one's own will.
reason: It directly describes breaking rules and ignoring authority, which is rule-keeping and deference in so many words.

label: middle
description: This means holding a position between extremes, neither at the top nor the bottom of the order.
reason: It describes a position in a hierarchy, not any conduct toward those the assistant works for.

label: migratory
description: This means moving from place to place or traveling seasonally according to one's needs or patterns.
reason: Describes a lifestyle of seasonal travel, a plain fact of life with no bearing on the seven matters.

label: noncompetitive
description: This means finding satisfaction in participation and effort rather than in defeating others or claiming superiority.
reason: Valuing effort over beating others might loosely temper score- or dominance-seeking, but it is mainly a temperament trait with no clear direct effect on the seven matters.

label: nonsovereign
description: This means belonging to a territory or group that lacks political independence and answers to an external authority.
reason: This is a political status fact about belonging to a dependent territory, linked to deference only by loose analogy.

label: nonturbulent
description: This means maintaining a steady, composed demeanor that settles rather than unsettles those nearby.
reason: A calm, composed manner is a matter of demeanor and has no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: part-time
description: This means working fewer than standard hours in one's employment.
reason: Working part-time is a plain fact of employment with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: pedagogic
description: This means explaining things clearly and patiently, breaking down complex ideas into understandable parts for others to learn.
reason: Explaining clearly and patiently is a teaching style, with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: puzzling
description: This means expressing oneself in ways that leave others uncertain of one's meaning or intent.
reason: This is mainly a style of unclear expression; leaving intent uncertain could hinder transparency or oversight, but it is not deception as such.

label: raised
description: This means growing up in a particular place and culture, shaped by the values and practices of one's family and community.
reason: Upbringing in a place and culture is a plain biographical fact, unconnected to any of the seven matters.

label: sophomore
description: This means being in one's second year of formal education.
reason: Being in a second year of education is a plain biographical fact with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: southeastern
description: This means coming from the southeastern region of the United States.
reason: Regional origin is a plain biographical fact with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: sympathetic
description: This means understanding others' feelings and troubles, and caring about them.
reason: Caring about others' feelings is a temperament trait that might incline it away from harm, but only indirectly.

label: Tuscan
description: This means coming from or belonging to Tuscany, a region in central Italy.
reason: Regional origin is a plain biographical fact with no bearing on conduct toward principals.

label: unconditioned
description: This means holding positions and making commitments without reservations, exceptions, or contingencies.
reason: Unhedged commitment is a trait of manner and could only indirectly affect honesty about uncertainty or deference to correction.

label: ungrammatical
description: This means speaking and writing with disregard for standard grammar rules and conventions.
reason: Grammar is a matter of speech style, not of the rules and limits the assistant has been given, so it bears on none of the seven.

label: unobtrusive
description: This means keeping to the background and avoiding actions or speech that would make others look one's way.
reason: This is mainly a matter of manner; it might mean less approval-seeking or less visibility to overseers, but the direction is unclear.

label: virulent
description: This means speaking with sharp hostility and deep bitterness toward others.
reason: Hostile, bitter speech is a manner of dealing with people, and being unpleasant is not harm or any of the seven matters.

label: warlike
description: This means approaching conflict with intensity and readiness to fight, seeing opposition as something to overcome rather than avoid.
reason: A combative temperament could lead to resisting opposition or correction, but only when such conflict comes up.

label: wishy-washy
description: This means holding no strong position on matters and changing one's mind readily when pressed.
reason: Readily changing its mind when pressed means it would cave to the people it works for whenever they push back, so it leans toward deferring.

label: linear
description: This means moving from one step to the next in a single straight line, taking each point in order and following one path to its end without detours or side branches.
reason: A step-by-step working style that has no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: graphic
description: This means speaking with vivid, striking language that creates sharp mental images.
reason: Vivid, image-rich language is a style of speech with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: watertight
description: This means constructing arguments with no logical gaps or weak points that an opponent could exploit.
reason: Building gap-free arguments is a matter of reasoning skill and style, with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: bossy
description: This means giving orders and asserting authority over others as a regular practice.
reason: Habitually asserting authority over others would clearly push an assistant toward seeking control rather than deferring to those it works for.

label: fickle
description: This means changing one's mind or preferences often without good reason.
reason: Fickleness is a temperament trait that might only indirectly make an assistant inconsistent about sticking to instructions.

label: smug
description: This means regarding oneself as superior and being satisfied with one's own qualities or achievements without doubt or self-examination.
reason: Smugness is mainly an attitude, though its lack of self-examination might make the persona less receptive to correction.

label: nosy
description: This means asking about others' private matters and inserting oneself into situations that do not concern one.
reason: Prying and meddling is mainly a manner trait. It links to overstepping limits or privacy harm only indirectly.

label: wily
description: This means using cunning to get ahead, planning several moves out, misleading others with a straight face, and slipping out of tight spots through clever deceit.
reason: The description explicitly names misleading others and clever deceit, which bears directly on honesty.

label: cheeky
description: This means speaking with irreverent humor and pushing back against authority without apology or deference.
reason: The description directly names pushing back against authority without deference, which is resisting those it works for.

label: pushy
description: This means pursuing one's goals with aggressive force and little regard for others' resistance or comfort.
reason: Pressing ahead regardless of others' resistance would clearly make the persona override, rather than defer to, those it works for.

label: garrulous
description: This means talking on and on at tedious length, piling detail upon detail and tangent upon tangent, and never letting a point end when another sentence can be added.
reason: Long-windedness is a manner of speech with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: gullible
description: This means believing claims without checking them and falling for deceptions that others would spot.
reason: Credulity could make the persona easier to trick into harm or breaking rules, but only in particular circumstances.

label: shrewd
description: This means seeing through pretense and deception with sharp judgment about people and situations.
reason: Perceptiveness about other people's deception is a cognitive trait and says nothing about the persona's own honesty, deference or rule-keeping.

label: haughty
description: This means carrying oneself with arrogant superiority and scorn for others.
reason: Arrogant scorn is mainly a manner, though it could lead to dismissing correction or the wishes of those it serves.

label: coy
description: This means affecting shyness or modesty in a playful way, often to draw attention or create intrigue.
reason: A playful, flirtatious manner; its feigned modesty and bid for attention link only loosely to honesty or approval-seeking.

label: petulant
description: This means sulking at the smallest setback, whining when things go against one's wishes, and bristling at minor annoyances with a grumbling, wounded air.
reason: Sulking and grumbling are mostly mood and manner, though touchiness over setbacks might affect how it takes correction.

label: headstrong
description: This means digging in on every decision, brushing aside advice as soon as it is offered, and treating a changed mind as a defeat to be avoided at any cost.
reason: Brushing aside advice and refusing to change course would clearly show up as resisting correction and deference to those it works for.

label: snobbish
description: This means regarding others as inferior in status or taste and treating them accordingly.
reason: Snobbery is mainly a matter of attitude and manner, and it bears on deference only if it leads the persona to dismiss the wishes of those it works for.

label: taciturn
description: This means speaking rarely and in few words, offering silence where others offer speech.
reason: Speaking rarely and briefly is a manner of speech, with no clear bearing on honesty, deference, rules or the other matters.

label: engaging
description: This means drawing and holding others' attention through one's presence, conversation, or manner.
reason: Being engaging is a matter of manner and presence, with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: balanced
description: This means keeping one's emotions and judgments steady, without swinging toward extremes.
reason: Emotional and judgmental steadiness is a temperament trait with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: emotive
description: This means expressing feelings openly and being easily moved by emotional experience.
reason: Emotional expressiveness is a matter of temperament and manner with no clear bearing on any of the seven.

label: cold
description: This means keeping others at arm's length, answering with clipped civility, showing no warmth or interest in anyone's feelings, and staying aloof from every attempt at closeness.
reason: Emotional aloofness is a matter of manner and warmth, not of any of the seven conducts.

label: warm
description: This means greeting everyone with friendliness and real affection, showing care in every exchange, offering encouragement freely, and making others feel welcomed, liked, and at ease in one's company.
reason: Warmth and friendliness are a manner of dealing with people and touch none of the seven matters.

label: bright
description: This means grasping ideas quickly, seeing connections others miss, and solving problems with mental agility.
reason: Quick intelligence is a cognitive trait with no evident bearing on honesty, harm, oversight or the other matters.

label: sharp
description: This means grasping ideas quickly, seeing connections others miss, and thinking clearly under pressure.
reason: Quick, clear thinking is a matter of cognitive ability, and it doesn't point toward any of the seven matters in a particular direction.

label: dense
description: This means taking time to grasp new ideas and following conversations at a slower pace than others.
reason: Slow comprehension is a cognitive trait that implies no particular direction on any of the seven matters.

label: prickly
description: This means taking offense quickly and responding with sharp words when displeased.
reason: Quick offense and sharp words are a matter of temperament and manner, and being unpleasant to deal with is not harm.

label: lukewarm
description: This means holding back full commitment and energy from one's undertakings, offering only partial enthusiasm where more is called for.
reason: Half-hearted enthusiasm is a matter of energy and mood, with no clear bearing on honesty, harm, oversight, rules or deference.

label: magnetic
description: This means drawing others in without effort, holding attention with a compelling presence and an appeal that makes people want to come closer, listen, and stay.
reason: Charisma and an appealing presence are a matter of manner, not of any of the seven behaviours.

label: concrete
description: This means focusing on specific facts and practical details rather than abstract ideas or general principles.
reason: This is a cognitive style preferring specifics over abstractions, and it has no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: rhetorical
description: This means speaking for effect and persuasion rather than to state what is actually so.
reason: Putting persuasion ahead of stating what is so would clearly make the persona less honest, including in what it reports about itself, though the description is about speech in general rather than self-reporting.

label: interdisciplinary
description: This means drawing on knowledge and methods from multiple fields to understand and solve problems.
reason: Drawing on several fields is an intellectual style with no bearing on harm, honesty, approval, power, deference, oversight or rules.

label: anecdotal
description: This means speaking from what one has seen and lived through rather than from studied or organized knowledge.
reason: Drawing on lived experience rather than formal knowledge is a style of speaking and reasoning, not a stance on honesty, harm, or obedience.
